description: An interactive field guide to NASA's Juno: the first solar-powered spacecraft at Jupiter, its pole-to-pole capture orbit of 8.1 million × 4,200 km, why a stuck valve kept it in 53-day orbits, Doppler tracking that showed Jupiter's jets run 3,000 km deep, polygons of polar cyclones, a lopsided magnetic field, and flybys of Ganymede, Europa and Io.
og: Pole-to-pole at 58 km/s on 450 watts of sunlight: Juno's orbit, Doppler gravity science and moon flybys, interactive and sourced.
brand: POLAR — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
